module: Flowgraph node "Rally Mode Recover To Route Departure" (category repeat_p_duration, tags rally, recover, teleport). Puts the vehicle back at the last tracked off-road recovery point, via gameplay_rally.getRallyManager():recoverVehicleToRouteDeparture(veh, {repairVehicle, backoffDistance}). Inputs: flow, vehId (otherwise player vehicle 0) and backoffDistance (distance upstream of the tracked point, along the static driveline). If repair is active, a fuel snapshot is taken before and reapplied after.
notes: Error logged if the rally manager cannot be found; warning with the reason if recoverVehicleToRouteDeparture fails.
Unlike recoverInPlace, this node does not itself emit the end-of-recovery hooks.

onNodeReset.desc: Clears the pending recovery and the fuel snapshot.

runRecovery.desc: Calls rm:recoverVehicleToRouteDeparture then reapplies the fuel if repaired.

startRecovery.desc: Prepares the pending recovery (vehicle, repair, backoffDistance) and launches it, after the fuel snapshot if needed.

work.desc: If flow is active, calls startRecovery.
